user.title: Tado X Proxy Thermostat
user.description: One entry controls exactly one Tado X climate entity. Over Matter that is one radiator thermostat (TRV): if a room has several radiators, add one entry per TRV and point them all at the same room temperature sensor. With the Tado X cloud integration (exabird/ha-tado-x) one climate entity drives the whole Tado room: add one entry per room and set the overlay refresh interval to 900 s afterwards (Configure → TRV Communication).

data_description.source_entity_id: Matter: the climate entity of the valve head mounted on the radiator. Tado X cloud integration: the climate entity of the Tado room. Do not select a wall thermostat here. Each climate entity can only be used by one entry.
data_description.external_temperature_entity_id: A temperature sensor placed in the room, away from the radiator. Use the same sensor for every entry belonging to that room.
data_description.name: Name of the proxy thermostat. Pick a descriptive name, for example "Lounge Window" and "Lounge Wall" for two radiators, or "Lounge" for a whole Tado room, so you can find the entities again in automations.

error.temp_not_a_sensor: Please select a sensor entity as the external temperature sensor.
error.temp_not_temperature: Please select a temperature sensor (device_class: temperature).

abort.already_configured: This thermostat is already used by another entry. Each climate entity can only be controlled by one proxy.

data.sensor_loss_action: When the room sensor stays unavailable

data_description.external_temperature_entity_id: A temperature sensor placed in the room, away from the radiator. Use the same sensor for every entry belonging to that room.
data_description.sensor_loss_action: What happens once the grace period for a missing room sensor has expired: keep the last command on the TRV, regulate with a backup room sensor, or let the TRV regulate on its own. An open window (frost protection) and turning the heating off always take priority.
data_description.backup_temperature_entity_id: Only used with the backup room sensor action. Pick a different sensor than the external temperature sensor.
data_description.boost_duration: How long a boost heats before your own choice comes back. Its time only runs while the boost is what heats the room.

data.window_action: Action while the window is open

data_description.window_sensor_id: Binary sensor that detects an open window. When triggered, the thermostat switches to frost protection.
data_description.window_action: Frost protection keeps the room at the frost protection temperature. Switch the TRV off turns it off completely. Either way your own choice comes back once the window has closed.
data_description.window_delay_s: Delay before frost protection is activated after the window opens.
data_description.window_close_delay_s: Wait after the window closes before your own choice comes back.

data_description.presence_sensor_id: Binary sensor that is on while somebody is home. When it reports nobody home, the room switches to Away.
data_description.presence_away_delay_s: Delay before switching to away mode after presence is lost.
data_description.presence_home_delay_s: Wait after someone comes home before your own choice comes back.

data_description.correction_kp: Proportional gain of the PI controller. Higher values react faster to temperature deviations.
data_description.correction_ki: Integral gain of the PI controller. Higher values correct persistent offsets more aggressively.
data_description.integral_deadband_c: Integral only accumulates when the error is within this zone. Prevents overshoot during large transients.

gain_scheduling.name: Gain Scheduling
gain_scheduling.description: Automatic Kp scaling based on temperature error.

data_description.gain_scheduling_enabled: Faster heating on cold start, gentler near target.
data_description.gain_fine_multiplier: Kp multiplier when close to target. Only active when adaptive gain scheduling is enabled.
data_description.gain_startup_multiplier: Kp multiplier during cold start (large error). Only active when adaptive gain scheduling is enabled.
data_description.gain_startup_threshold_c: Error above this threshold activates cold-start multiplier.
data_description.gain_fine_threshold_c: Error below this threshold activates near-target multiplier.

data_description.min_command_interval_s: Minimum time between commands sent to the TRV (battery conservation).
data_description.min_change_threshold_c: Minimum difference to the current Tado setpoint before a new command is sent.
data_description.overlay_refresh_s: Resend an unchanged setpoint after this long, so timer overlays do not expire. Tado X cloud integration (exabird/ha-tado-x): 900 s. Matter: 0 = off.

data_description.sensor_grace_s: How long to use the last valid reading when the external sensor becomes unavailable.
data_description.follow_threshold_c: Minimum difference from last-sent setpoint to treat a Tado change as physical user input.
data_description.follow_grace_s: Grace period after a command during which Tado setpoint changes are ignored (acknowledgement delay).
data_description.urgent_decrease_threshold_c: Bypass rate limiting when the new target is this much below the current Tado setpoint.

error.backup_sensor_required: Choose a backup room sensor for this action.
error.backup_sensor_same: The backup room sensor must differ from the external temperature sensor.
error.temp_not_temperature: Please select a temperature sensor (device_class: temperature).

options.backup_sensor: Regulate with a backup room sensor
options.trv: Let the TRV regulate on its own
